digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow completion recovery and gate error reporting
propositions: Step-budget exhaustion computes a repetition diagnostic (tool_calls_distinct, max_consecutive_repeat, top_repeated_tool_calls) via usage_log.failure_usage but the diagnostic is discarded before reaching the operator message because _bounded_diagnostic strips these fields from the exception diagnostic

The gate_error_v1 sidecar is only emitted by raise_completion_workflow_failure when failure_diagnostic is truthy, but budget exhaustion exceptions never set failure_diagnostic because they do not reach CompletionAgentStep._recover
The operator-facing close-gate failure message contains no loop-vs-budget discriminator, forcing operators to manually escalate the budget against a constraint that may not be the actual bottleneck

_bounded_diagnostic must be widened to allowlist repetition keys (tool_calls_distinct, max_consecutive_repeat, top_repeated_tool_calls, distinct_ratio_window) and permit list-valued top_repeated_tool_calls through the merge(), then raise_completion_workflow_failure must project aggregate_-prefixed keys back to bare names and render them through format_repetition
The sidecar payload and message rendering must preserve the privacy contract: no prompts, tool arguments, or response text, only hashed signatures and counters
